nodes.summary: Let $S_1, S_2, R$ be integers, let $U$ and $W$ be integer sequences forming a cubic recurrence pair for $(S_1, S_2, R)$, and let $D_n = \gcd(W_n - 6R^n, U_n)$ be their discriminant sequence. Then for all integers $n \ge 1$ and $m \ge 1$, $D_n$ divides $D_{nm}$.
nodes.title: Divisibility of the cubic-recurrence discriminants

nodes.summary: For an integer $R$ and integer sequences $U$ and $W$, the discriminant sequence is $D_n = \gcd(W_n - 6R^n, U_n)$ for $n \ge 0$: the greatest common divisor of the natural numbers $|W_n - 6R^n|$ and $|U_n|$.
nodes.title: Cubic-recurrence discriminant sequence

nodes.summary: For integers $S_1, S_2, R$ and a complex number $\gamma$, put $\rho = R(\gamma + \gamma^{-1})$ (with the convention $0^{-1} = 0$) and $S_3 = RS_1^2 - 2RS_2 - 4R^3$. The root condition holds when $\rho$ is a root of the cubic $x^3 - S_1x^2 + S_2x - S_3$, that is, when $\rho^3 - S_1\rho^2 + S_2\rho - S_3 = 0$.
nodes.title: Root condition for the Roettger–Williams cubic

nodes.summary: Integer sequences $U$ and $W$ form a cubic recurrence pair for integers $S_1, S_2, R$ when there are pairwise distinct complex numbers $\gamma_1, \gamma_2, \gamma_3$, each different from $1$, with $\gamma_1\gamma_2\gamma_3 = 1$, such that each $\gamma_i$ satisfies the cubic recurrence root condition for $(S_1, S_2, R)$, $U_0 = 0$,…
nodes.title: Cubic recurrence pair

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
